exclusion_detail: The lead (BM30; its cell-permeable analogue DC432) is a peptidomimetic made by standard Fmoc solid-phase synthesis on Rink amide resin and cleaved with a TFA cocktail (main text, Experimental), i.e. a peptide-type compound, not a small-molecule route from commercial building blocks.

lead.label: BM30
lead.why: Abstract: 'the rational design and development of the first potent peptidomimetic inhibitor for NTMT1/2 ... BM30 (IC50 0.89 +/- 0.10 uM)'; DC432 is named as its cell-permeable analogue.

notes: All compounds in the paper are peptide/peptidomimetic SPPS products (Fmoc-amino acids on resin).
